parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: Page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: Department that the user belongs to. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: DeviceType
parameters.description:
Operating system type of the endpoint device. Valid values:

- **windows**: Windows.

- **macos**: macOS.

- **linux**: Linux.

- **android**: Android.

- **ios**: iOS.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Certificate status. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.
